source_claim: The official Harry Potter encyclopedia and Wizarding World editorial guides identify the named campaign characters as members of the Harry Potter book/film story world. Fact Files provide direct character profiles and appearances; official Weasley, Gryffindor, Cursed Child, and editorial entries corroborate the family, character, and series relationships.
notes: Official sources consulted: Harry Potter Fact Files directory (https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file) and profiles for Hermione Granger (https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/characters-and-pets/hermione-granger), Ginny Weasley (https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/characters-and-pets/ginny-weasley), and Hedwig (https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/characters-and-pets/hedwig); the official Weasleys entry (https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/magical-miscellany/the-weasleys), Burrow residents (https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/locations/the-burrow), and Gryffindor connections (https://www.harrypotter.com/fact-file/magical-miscellany/gryffindor) explicitly place Fred, George, Ginny, and Ron in the family/story world. The official Cursed Child guide identifies Albus Severus Potter and Scorpius Malfoy (https://www.harrypotter.com/features/cursed-child-character-guide). The official adult-character guide names James Potter as Harry's father, Lily Potter, and Severus Snape (https://www.harrypotter.com/features/the-hogwarts-house-of-every-grown-up-in-harry-potter); the Lily profile explains her birth surname Evans (https://www.harrypotter.com/features/unsung-heroes-of-harry-potter-stories-lily-potter). Official Wizarding World articles identify Draco Malfoy (https://www.harrypotter.com/writing-by-jk-rowling/draco-malfoy), Luna Lovegood (https://www.harrypotter.com/features/the-kindness-of-luna-lovegood), and Pansy Parkinson among Rowling's original forty characters (https://www.harrypotter.com/writing-by-jk-rowling/the-original-forty). These are direct canonical character attestations, not fan-derived or inferred relationship paths.
